source.title: RPMS: Enhancing LLM-Based Embodied Planning through Rule-Augmented Memory Synergy

mechanism.pre_injection_gate: State-Consistent Filtering (SCF) screens each recalled entry against a deterministic current belief-state signature before prompt injection.
mechanism.alfworld_signature: sigma(b_t)=(location, hand_state); compatibility requires matching hand occupancy.
mechanism.scienceworld_extension: Compatibility checks instrument availability, room match and bounded progress alignment.
mechanism.arbitration: After SCF, rules-first hard filtering removes direct rule conflicts and soft annotation marks non-direct conflicts.

controlled_evidence.memory_freeze: After Round 1, the 233-entry ALFWorld memory is frozen before evaluation and shared across ablation conditions; no online learning occurs during evaluation.

scf_ablation.interpretation: With the stored memory snapshot fixed, removing retrieval-time state consistency reduces success, isolating a receiver-side applicability check more directly than prior memory-presence ablations.

per_task_negative_transfer.interpretation: Unfiltered/ungrounded memory can be harmful on a task subset.

protocol_implication.name: PER_DECISION_MEMORY_COMPATIBILITY_GATE
protocol_implication.rule: A retrieved/admitted memory is still only a candidate. Immediately before each decision-step injection, revalidate it against the current compact state signature and current compatibility policy. State or candidate-set drift invalidates cached compatibility. Empty injection is legal.
protocol_implication.separation: Admission/retrieval identity and per-use applicability are separate lifecycle gates.

scope_limits: The exact isolated SCF delta is reported for ALFWorld, not ScienceWorld.
ScienceWorld provides transfer evidence for the same explicit compatibility mechanism and full-system gains, but the paper does not report a numerical ScienceWorld SCF-off delta.
Different backbones are used across ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, so cross-environment score differences are not model-controlled comparisons.
No official public RPMS code repository was located in the current search; implementation-revision binding remains unresolved.
